name: Earth Elemental
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.description: The elemental can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing the material it moves through.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The elemental deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The elemental makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

description: Earth elementals are slow, hulking masses of living stone and soil, plowing through walls and burrowing through solid ground to crush intruders beneath crumbling fists.
